description: List the tokens and NFT collections listed in the Insumer registry. Filter by chain, symbol, or asset type. The registry is a directory, not the list of what can be checked: an attestation can check any token on a supported chain, and NFTs on EVM chains, Solana and XRPL, whether listed or not. An empty result means nothing is listed under that filter, not that the token is unsupported.
name: insumer_list_tokens

data.description: The endpoint's payload: a signed attestation, trust profile, discount, merchant or token records

error.description: Error details when ok is false

items.description: The result when the endpoint returns a JSON array

message.description: A plain-text result (insumer_setup), or a message from the API

meta.description: Response metadata such as version and timestamp

ok.description: true when the API call succeeded

title: List registered tokens
